title: Viewpoint
description: TOGAF-sourced justification archetype — Architecture Viewpoint. Defines the property vocabulary for architecture viewpoints that frame how architecture content is presented to stakeholders and what concerns each view addresses. Rootless archetype — used to type viewpoint records in governance justification. TOGAF mapping: Viewpoint (Architecture Content Framework — a specification of the conventions for constructing and using an Architecture View; ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010). Source framework: TOGAF (Architecture Content Framework, Views and Viewpoints).

audience.description: Target audience roles for this viewpoint (e.g., 'Enterprise Architect', 'Developer', 'Operations'). TOGAF mapping: Stakeholder roles that this viewpoint serves.

framingConcerns.description: Concern categories this viewpoint addresses. TOGAF mapping: the set of Concerns that the viewpoint frames for its audience.

notation.description: Modeling notation or format for views created from this viewpoint (e.g., 'ArchiMate', 'UML', 'BPMN', 'C4'). TOGAF mapping: viewpoint modeling technique.
